verdict.rationale: Agents built with the SDK are fundamentally driven by natural-language instructions and inputs (agents are 'configured with instructions' and run via Runner.run() on natural-language input/output), so the core interaction model is NL-based. However, the SDK itself is configured and orchestrated via Python/JS code, not operated through a natural-language command interface for the 'AI-native user' persona — there's no evidence of a chat/CLI-style meta-interface to control the SDK's own behavior via NL. Missing for 10: evidence of a natural-language control surface for the SDK/product itself (vs. just NL as agent input/output), and independent corroboration of this usage pattern.
